title: Port the Field Counter ItemStack storage API
preconditions: Confirmed Fabric and Mojang mapping declarations; exact source and target versions.
The designated file matches the reviewed source values.
postconditions: The complete designated change matches the reviewed target; a second run is a no-op.
behavioral_differences: Store the same integer key under minecraft:custom_data. Reads default to zero and writes update only that key.
limitations: The Java rule recognizes the exact original Field Counter storage helper. Other ItemStack patterns require source review.
The route does not establish compatibility for arbitrary mods or upgraded worlds.
verification_evidence: Field Counter compiled against the 1.20.4 and 1.20.6 Minecraft artifacts; counter parity probes ran on both versions.
